title: SysV / POSIX IPC subsystem implementation
summary: Implement the full SysV + POSIX IPC subsystem family (sem, shm, msg, mq) per 08_SYSV_IPC_v1.md. Four phases: shm → msg → sem → POSIX wrappers. ~4,000 LoC, zero framework changes.

out: No new YieldShape, ExecutionScope, AbortReason, bus primitive, RestrictionKind

write_sets.notes: Single-threaded implementation; phases are sequential with verification gates between each.

steps.title: IPC-0: Module scaffold, IpcNamespace, crate registration
steps.notes: Create module tree per 08_SYSV_IPC_v1.md §3. Add IpcNamespace to NsProxy. Register in lib.rs.

steps.title: IPC-1: SysV shared memory (shmget, shmat, shmdt, shmctl)
steps.notes: ShmSegmentIdentity / ShmSegmentPayload. IpcNamespace.sysv_shm table. step_shmget/step_shmat/step_shmdt/step_shmctl. /proc/sysvipc/shm projection. Zero new WaitSources (page-fault is existing).

steps.title: IPC-2: SysV message queues (msgget, msgsnd, msgrcv, msgctl)
steps.notes: MsgQueueIdentity / MsgQueuePayload. per-type buckets + queue_seq counter. send_source / recv_source WaitSources. step_msgget/step_msgsnd/step_msgrcv (atomic + sequenced predicates)/step_msgctl. /proc/sysvipc/msg projection.

steps.title: IPC-3: SysV semaphores (semget, semop, semctl) + SEM_UNDO
steps.notes: SemArrayIdentity / SemArrayPayload. sem_changed_source WaitSource + sem_changed_seq. step_semget/step_semop (multi-op atomic/sequenced predicate)/step_semctl. SEM_UNDO: ProcessPayload.sem_undos + exit-step walk. /proc/sysvipc/sem projection.

steps.title: IPC-4: POSIX wrappers (mq_open, mq_send, mq_receive, mq_notify, mq_unlink)
steps.notes: PosixMqInstance fd-shaped wrapper. step_mq_open/step_mq_send/step_mq_receive/step_mq_notify/step_mq_unlink. WaitProtocol.deadline for timed variants. mq_notify SIGEV_SIGNAL attachment row. POSIX sem named: /dev/shm tmpfs file + SemArrayPayload reuse.

steps.title: IPC-5: Syscall dispatch table entries for all new syscalls
steps.notes: Register all ~30 new syscall numbers and dispatch entries. Verify no-collision with existing numbers.

verification.notes: Full workspace check after each phase
Unit tests for each IPC kind

risks: SEM_UNDO exit-step integration may require process-exit changes beyond the IPC module
IpcNamespace on NsProxy requires updating all NsProxy construction sites
ShmSegment requires PageBacked/RNodeBacking integration that may expose gaps in the existing PageContainer interface
